set.body:
Current release programme, reconciled 2026-10-24 at origin/main 360a326b.
Owner accepted the joint library + Studio 1.0 scope on bd-01M4GMYCF5V682M7GJDJH1HTPH (2026-10-09). Meridian integration is deferred by the owner (2026-10-24).

One root, four delivery groups (existing IDs retained):
A. Application hardening: bd-01M4GMY9B0WS55XNXJ32JQ27DA. Small-window usability, Results focus-model reconciliation, safe project-part retention, deterministic native FX input/render-failure checks, default fork-handshake receipt reconciliation.
B. Real-study acceptance: bd-01M4GMY8M40PE6RQC7S55T8K91. G2 bd-01M3DPG3KTRQNN6HKWRHYQTT0C owns both acquisition declarations and the complete standard-host journey; no separate data-request milestone.
C. Studio release candidate and qualification: bd-01M4GMYAFYXKYKSDNQP343MX1T. Accessibility, measured performance, bundled macOS application, researcher usability, then G5.
D. Library acceptance and publication: bd-01M4GMY9X1DY2BAP79Z48W177W. One pre-publication audit, documentation-runtime resolution, Central publication/consumer proof, compatibility policy and baseline.

Verified complete: G0, G1, G3, G4, S10.4; native entry point uses SessionBackend.Real. Latest software qualification: docs/studio/evidence/20261024-results-matrix/qualification.json (candidate779fb468; 5234 Studio passes; 24 E2E scenarios; Linux1x/nativeGTK2x/macOS courts). Private G2, physical Mac Retina/VoiceOver, performance, packaging and researcher usability are separate unqualified obligations.

Work order: small-window + Results focus first; retention/native harness work in bounded slices; performance harness and packaging build can start alongside those. Complete G2 facts/journey and prepare human review protocol early. Freeze and qualify the combined release candidate after fixes. Run the full gate once per source batch, not once per tracker alias. No new full gate is needed for this tracker-only consolidation.

Scope control: post-v1 stays under bd-01M4GMYB467Q1TEVTQTZY3DT0W. Separate MultiMatch workbench redesign, Pic_sequences paper-replication experiments, full current Scaladock adoption and deprecated wire-prose retirement are deferred; their evidence and tickets remain. A real production-path defect discovered in validation becomes a bounded release blocker, not a new scientific-method programme.

Closure means acceptance passed or explicitly consolidated into a named live successor. Historical notes are preserved. Missing empirical/manual evidence stays open. The joint release closes only after all four groups close.
